title: PyPose v0.6: The Imperative Programming Interface for Robotics
venue: IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS) Workshop
tldr: An open-source library that trains robot learning and physics-based optimization end to end; v0.6 improves usability, examples, and the MPC module.
authors: Zitong Zhan, Xiangfu Li, Qihang Li, …, Junyi Geng, Chen Wang

title: Data-driven Shape Sensing of Continuum Dexterous Manipulators Using Embedded Capacitive Sensor
tldr: An embedded capacitive sensor and a data-driven model estimate the shape of a continuum dexterous manipulator at low cost, with sub-centimeter accuracy on a prototype.
authors: Qihang Li, Wenpeng Wang, Joshua Liu, Amit Jain, Mehran Armand

title: Advancing Hand Rehabilitation: A Novel 3D-Printed Soft Pneumatic Glove for Enhanced Mixed Reality Interaction
tldr: A 3D-printed soft pneumatic glove for hand rehabilitation that works with mixed-reality interaction.
authors: Shaopeng Jiang†, Qihang Li†, Lingyun Di, Yaqian Chen, Wenpeng Wang, Jeremy D. Brown

title: iKap: Kinematics-aware Planning with Imperative Learning
venue: IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA)
tldr: Training a vision-to-planning network with the robot's kinematics inside the loop gives feasible trajectories, with higher success and lower latency.
authors: Qihang Li, Zhuoqun Chen, Haoze Zheng, Haonan He, Zitong Zhan, Shaoshu Su, Junyi Geng, Chen Wang

title: Imperative Learning: A Self-supervised Neural-Symbolic Learning Framework for Robot Autonomy
venue: The International Journal of Robotics Research (IJRR)
tldr: A self-supervised neuro-symbolic framework that couples a neural network with symbolic reasoning through bilevel optimization, shown on planning, control, odometry, and routing.
authors: Chen Wang, Kaiyi Ji, Junyi Geng, …, Qihang Li, …, Zhipeng Zhao

title: MRI-CORE: A Foundation Model for Magnetic Resonance Imaging
tldr: A large-scale pre-trained model for MRI, trained on over 6 million slices from 110 thousand volumes, that improves segmentation, classification, and zero-shot tasks.
authors: Haoyu Dong, Yuwen Chen, Hanxue Gu, Nicholas Konz, Yaqian Chen, Qihang Li, Maciej A. Mazurowski

title: Are Vision Foundation Models Ready for Out-of-the-Box Medical Image Registration?
tldr: Five pre-trained encoders on breast MRI registration: SAM beats traditional baselines under domain shift, but none capture fine fibroglandular detail.
authors: Hanxue Gu, Yaqian Chen, Nicholas Konz, Qihang Li, Maciej A. Mazurowski

title: BreastSegNet: Multi-label Segmentation of Breast MRI
tldr: A multi-label segmentation model for nine structures in breast MRI, trained on 1,123 expert-reviewed slices, with an average Dice of 0.694.
authors: Qihang Li, Jichen Yang, Yaqian Chen, Yuwen Chen, Hanxue Gu, Lars J. Grimm, Maciej A. Mazurowski

title: Accelerating Volumetric Medical Image Annotation via Short-Long Memory SAM 2
tldr: Separate short- and long-term memory banks reduce error propagation in SAM 2 and cut the time to correct propagated masks by about 61% per volume.
authors: Yuwen Chen, Zafer Yildiz, Qihang Li, Yaqian Chen, Haoyu Dong, Hanxue Gu, Nicholas Konz, Maciej A. Mazurowski

title: Automated Glenoid Bone Loss Measurement and Segmentation in CT Scans for Pre-operative Planning in Shoulder Instability
tldr: An automated pipeline measures glenoid bone loss on CT and agrees with the surgeon consensus better than surgeons agree with each other (ICC 0.84 vs. 0.78).
authors: Zhonghao Liu, Hanxue Gu, Qihang Li, Michael Fox, Jay M. Levin, Maciej A. Mazurowski, Brian C. Lau

title: A Hierarchical Laser Control Strategy for Spatially Uniform Thermal Dose Delivery in Laser-Induced Thermal Therapy
tldr: A hierarchical controller for laser power that aims to deliver a spatially uniform thermal dose in laser-induced thermal therapy.
authors: Jinsong Wu, Muhammad Muddassir, Qihang Li, David Navarro-Alarcon, Peng Zhou

title: GuidedMorph: Two-Stage Deformable Registration for Breast MRI
venue: IEEE Journal of Biomedical and Health Informatics (J-BHI)
tldr: Two-stage breast MRI registration that aligns globally, then tracks dense tissue, improving dense-tissue alignment by over 13% against baselines.
authors: Yaqian Chen, Hanxue Gu, Haoyu Dong, Qihang Li, Yuwen Chen, Nicholas Konz, Lin Li, Maciej A. Mazurowski

title: Execution-time Perceptual Degradation Diagnosis and Recovery for Resilient Robot Systems
tldr: Diagnosing perceptual degradation while a robot executes a task, and recovering from it, to keep robot systems resilient.
authors: Feifei Qiao, Qihang Li, Peng Gao

title: Skeleton-Conditioned Base Placement Evaluation for Long-Horizon Mobile Manipulation
tldr: Predicts whether a whole plan can work from one base pose, so planning tries promising bases first and saves time.
authors: Qihang Li, Yixuan Huang, Tom Silver, Peng Gao

title: Communication-Efficient Relative Pose Estimation with Vision Foundation Models for Ephemeral Collaborative Perception
venue: International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS)
tldr: Screen overlap cheaply, request images selectively, and keep relative pose continuous when the shared view disappears.
authors: Qihang Li, Jo-Hao Huang, Jiewen Liu, Suyoung Kang, Hao Zhang, Peng Gao
